summary.text: Ronald Itnyre is the Democratic candidate for Indiana State Senate District 27 in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A college professor, he campaigns on the themes "Smart Taxes, Strong Schools, and Protect Farms."

paragraphs.text: In a Ballotpedia survey, Ron Itnyre said he grew up on a 300-acre corn and beef farm and earned a doctorate in plant pathology, after which he worked as a corn breeder.
He is a professor and Director of Sustainability at Indiana University East.

Itnyre said his priorities are property tax relief balanced against local services, stable public school funding including career and technical education, and support for family farms and rural communities.
